Maria (CS): Heads up — we're kicking off 'adopter orientation' for the new early-access group next Tue. Need ops + enablement to sync handoff. Quick coord?
Sam (Solutions): Thanks. What's the expected size and critical success metric?
Maria (CS): ~12 companies, each 2 seats. Main KPI: Time-to-first-successful-inference < 48h, and collect first-week qualitative feedback. Renewal risk: low but need ramp docs.
Devon (CSM): Can we get a list of contacts? I'll own outreach + weekly check-ins. @Tia can you lead the orientation session?
Tia (Enablement): Yep. I can run a 30m orientation + a live Q&A. Want to split into 'setup' (20m) and 'best practices' (10m). Do we have a canonical deck?
Carl (Product): I'll share the new 'quickstart' deck link in a moment — it's got updated latency/cost guidance and ops checklist. Also recommend recording.
Sam (Solutions): Ops: we need to provision dedicated capacity or confirm hosted limits. @ops-bot confirm if next-Tue slot has capacity for burst?
ops-bot: ops-bot: checked cluster: hosted capacity is fine for 12 concurrent light sessions. Dedicated pools require request via ticket #INF-4123.
Maria (CS): If dedicated is optional, let's use hosted for orientation and open dedicated for pilot customers who need SLA.
Devon (CSM): Survey template for feedback? I can adapt the NPS + 3 open prompts. Will ask for 'ease of setup' and 'expected latency' notes.
Tia (Enablement): Can someone add a calendar invite with agenda + prep steps? Also include access instructions for API keys and a small snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
Sam (Solutions): I'll create the invite and include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/docs/ea-orient-runbook
Maria (CS): Sweet. Action items: Sam — invite + runbook link, Carl — deck, Devon — contacts + survey, Tia — slides + recording. I'll compile a single handoff doc and ping CS channel tomorrow. :thumbsup:
